digest.component_or_area: reconciler vendor adapter seam / ADR governance
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record the jira_family layer, shared-jira provenance decision, and the March 2029 DC read-only horizon, with all three stale statements corrected (diagram comment, prose, and Decision item 6).

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only conditionally: the port must be complete and typed; a live crash occurred (set_entity_property) while isinstance, contract suite, and 1636 unit tests passed, showing 21 transport members called vs 6 declared vs 12 absent in DC.
RemoteRef.instance is intended design with a gap: never constructed in production code (only test helpers exist), so the ADR must not assert it as existing reality; the gap is tracked separately.

Documentation must state DC least-privilege expectations (scoped PAT, dedicated account), allow_insecure/ca_bundle/resolved_statuses config keys, and that operators must run documented commands on a live DC instance to prove the guide works.

The jira-family sub-seam is shared by dependency inversion for ADR 0035 phase 1 modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py remain path-pinned, importing from jira_family/ instead), with phase 2 relocation deferred.
Live execution evidence required: the documented user-guide commands must execute successfully against the jira-dc-harness CI job to prove the documentation path is real.
